$comment: Documented API of upstream ZX BASIC #include libraries (upstream v1.19.0). Derived from the upstream documentation, CC BY 4.0, (c) Jose Rodriguez-Rosa (Boriel) and contributors; summaries paraphrased. This is the contract Klive BASIC implements in its own standard library; no library code is taken from upstream. See .ai/kbasic/README.md.

libraries.name: asc.bas
libraries.summary: ASCII code of the n-th character of a string; FreeBASIC compatible; 0 beyond end.

libraries.name: attr.bas
libraries.summary: Attribute byte at (row, col); rows 22/23 allowed; auto with --sinclair.

libraries.name: attrAddress.bas
libraries.summary: Attribute memory address for a character position (copy listing).

libraries.name: clearBox.bas
libraries.summary: Blank the pixels of a character-square rectangle (copy listing).

libraries.name: csrlin.bas
libraries.summary: Row of the text cursor.

libraries.name: distance.bas
libraries.summary: Fast approximate SQR(x^2+y^2) for bytes (copy listing).

libraries.name: doubleSizePrint.bas
libraries.summary: Double-size character/string printing (copy listing).

libraries.name: fastPlot.bas
libraries.summary: Fast OVER 0 pixel plot without attributes; optional screen-tables variant (copy listing).

libraries.name: fsin.bas / fmath.bas
libraries.summary: Fast Fixed-point trig in degrees, ~0.25% accuracy; page says bundled as fmath.bas.

libraries.name: fSqrt.bas
libraries.summary: Newton-Raphson Float square root, ~6x faster than ROM SQR, same accuracy.

libraries.name: hex.bas
libraries.summary: Hexadecimal string conversion for 32/16/8-bit unsigned values.

libraries.name: hMirror.bas
libraries.summary: Reverse bit order of a byte (copy listing; use the second, faster version).

libraries.name: HRPrint.bas
libraries.summary: Print a character at any pixel position with attributes and OVER modes.

libraries.name: HRPrintFast.bas
libraries.summary: Table-driven HRPrint, ~20% faster; needs Screentables.asm/RotateTables.asm from forum.

libraries.name: input42.bas
libraries.summary: Line input echoed through print42; always returns a string.

libraries.name: iSqrt.bas
libraries.summary: Integer square root of a uLong, 50-100x faster than ROM (copy listing).

libraries.name: keys.bas
libraries.summary: Standard library: fast keyboard scanning without the ROM; scan-code constants per row half.
libraries.arch: ZX Spectrum keyboard; no ROM needed

libraries.name: keys.bas (GetKey)
libraries.summary: Wait for a key and return its ASCII code (UByte).

libraries.name: keys.bas (GetKeyScanCode)
libraries.summary: Scan code of pressed key(s) ORed, 0 if none; no wait.

libraries.name: keys.bas (MultiKeys)
libraries.summary: Test several keys at once (same row half).

libraries.name: megalz.bas
libraries.summary: MegaLZ v4 decompressor wrapper (110-byte relocatable depacker).

libraries.name: memorybank.bas
libraries.summary: Paged RAM management at $c000 (and copy-to-$8000) for 128K models.

libraries.name: memorybank.bas (GetBank)
libraries.summary: Bank currently at $c000 (from BANKM).

libraries.name: memorybank.bas (SetBank)
libraries.summary: Page a bank into $c000-$ffff and update BANKM.

libraries.name: memorybank.bas (SetCodeBank)
libraries.summary: Copy a bank to $8000 (per memorybank.md); destroys bank 2; book chapter 14 architecture.

libraries.name: pixelScroll.bas
libraries.summary: Scroll the pixel screen up N rows (attributes untouched); needs ScreenTables.bas.

libraries.name: point.bas
libraries.summary: Pixel test at (x, y); auto with --sinclair.

libraries.name: pos.bas
libraries.summary: Column of the text cursor.

libraries.name: print42.bas
libraries.summary: 42-column (6 px) fixed-width text printing.

libraries.name: print64.bas
libraries.summary: 64-column (4 px) fixed-width text printing with its own cursor.

libraries.name: Print64x32.bas
libraries.summary: 64x32 grid text (2048 positions), no attributes; needs ScreenTables.asm from forum.

libraries.name: propPrint.bas
libraries.summary: Proportional text printing at pixel positions (copy listing).

libraries.name: putchars.bas
libraries.summary: Block graphics and attribute painting at character coordinates; no bounds checks (copy listing).

libraries.name: putTile.bas
libraries.summary: PUSH/POP-based 2x2 character tile blit with attributes; disables interrupts (copy listing).

libraries.name: randomStream.bas
libraries.summary: Integer/Fixed random numbers from Patrik Rak's stream generator (copy listing).

libraries.name: scrAddress.bas
libraries.summary: Screen and attribute addresses for a character cell (copy listing).

libraries.name: screen.bas
libraries.summary: Character at (row, col); auto with --sinclair.

libraries.name: stdlib (index)
libraries.summary: Index of bundled standard libraries: keys.bas and string.bas; some libraries may be architecture-specific (none flagged).

libraries.name: string.bas
libraries.summary: Standard library string slicing; strings are 0-based unless --string-base=1.

libraries.name: string.bas (left)
libraries.summary: First N chars.

libraries.name: string.bas (mid)
libraries.summary: N chars from a 0-based start.

libraries.name: string.bas (right)
libraries.summary: Last N chars.

libraries.name: windowAttrScrollUP.bas
libraries.summary: Scroll a window's attributes up one row (copy listing).

libraries.name: windowPaint.bas
libraries.summary: Set attributes of a rectangle without touching pixels (copy listing).

libraries.name: windowScrollUP.bas
libraries.summary: Scroll a window's pixels up one character row (copy listing).

libraries.name: zx0.bas
libraries.summary: Einar Saukas' ZX0 decompressors (src, dst); free to use, credit requested.

routines.name: ASC
routines.summary: ASCII code of the n-th character of a string (FreeBASIC compatibility).
routines.notes: Returns 0 rather than an error when n is beyond the string length. Library function; must be included.

routines.name: ATTR
routines.summary: Returns the colour attribute byte of the screen cell at (row, col).
routines.notes: Extends Sinclair BASIC: rows 22 and 23 allowed. Available without #include when compiling with -Z/--sinclair (zxb.md). Sample on page calls ATTR$(9, 10), inconsistent with the documented ATTR(row, col).

routines.name: attrAddress
syntax: attrAddress(x as uByte, y as uByte) as uInteger
routines.summary: Returns the address of the attribute byte for character position (x, y).
routines.notes: Not bundled: copy the listing (also repeated in docs/library/scraddress.md). Example: poke attrAddress(10,10),43.

routines.name: BLAttrWindowScrollUp
syntax: BLAttrWindowScrollUp(X AS UBYTE, Y AS UBYTE, Width AS UBYTE, Height AS UBYTE)
routines.summary: Scrolls the colour attributes of a character window up by one row.
routines.notes: Companion to BLWindowScrollUp; leaves the last line's attributes untouched. Not bundled (copy listing).

routines.name: BLWindowScrollUp
syntax: BLWindowScrollUp(X as uByte, Y as uByte, Width as uByte, Height as uByte)
routines.summary: Scrolls a rectangular character window of the pixel screen up by one character row and blanks the last row.
routines.notes: Intended for text windows (e.g. adventures); attributes not scrolled. Not bundled.

routines.name: clearBox
syntax: clearBox(x as uByte, y as uByte, width as uByte, height as uByte)
routines.summary: Blanks the pixels of a rectangle measured in character squares.
routines.notes: No error checking at all. Attributes untouched. Not bundled.

routines.name: CSRLIN
routines.summary: Row (line) of the text cursor, 0 = top.
routines.notes: Not in Sinclair BASIC.

routines.name: distance
syntax: FUNCTION fastcall distance(a as ubyte, b as ubyte) as uInteger
routines.summary: Very fast integer approximation of SQR(a^2 + b^2).
routines.notes: Error up to ~10% as inputs approach 255. Benchmark on page: distance 8.98 s vs iSqrt 50.1 s vs fSqrt 2625 s vs ROM SQR 7337 s. Not bundled.

routines.name: doubleSizePrint
syntax: doubleSizePrint(y as uByte, x as uByte, thingToPrint$ as String)
routines.summary: Prints a string in double-size characters starting at (y, x).
routines.notes: Stops at screen edge; no wrapping. Not bundled.

routines.name: doubleSizePrintChar
syntax: doubleSizePrintChar(y as uByte, x as uByte, thingToPrint as uByte)
routines.summary: Prints one character (ASCII code, incl. UDGs 144-164) at double size.
routines.notes: 143 bytes; silently ignores out-of-range input. Not bundled.

routines.name: dzx0AgileRCS
routines.summary: ZX0 decompressor variant (agile, RCS screen layout).
routines.notes: Example decompresses an RCS+ZX0 image straight to 16384. Mention ZX0 in your docs as requested by its author.

routines.name: dzx0Mega
routines.summary: ZX0 decompressor, mega (fastest/largest) variant.

routines.name: dzx0MegaBack
routines.summary: Backwards variant of dzx0Mega.

routines.name: dzx0SmartRCS
routines.summary: ZX0 decompressor for RCS-encoded screens (smart variant).

routines.name: dzx0SmartRCSBack
routines.summary: Backwards variant of dzx0SmartRCS.

routines.name: dzx0Standard
routines.summary: ZX0 decompressor, standard (smallest) variant.

routines.name: dzx0StandardBack
routines.summary: Backwards variant of dzx0Standard.

routines.name: dzx0Turbo
routines.summary: ZX0 decompressor, turbo variant.
routines.notes: Example: dzx0Turbo(51200, 16384).

routines.name: dzx0TurboBack
routines.summary: Backwards variant of dzx0Turbo.

routines.name: fastPlot
syntax: fastPlot(x as uByte, y as uByte)
routines.summary: Plots one pixel in OVER 0 mode at high speed, ignoring attributes.
routines.notes: Two versions: plain (~8,500 px/s) and a screen-tables version (~10,000 px/s) that needs the ScreenTables label included once. Not bundled.

routines.name: fCos
routines.summary: Fast Fixed-point cosine in DEGREES, implemented as fSin(90 - num).
routines.notes: About 0.25% accuracy; requires fSin. Page says the library is bundled as fmath.bas although the page is named fsin.bas.

routines.name: fSin
routines.summary: Fast Fixed-point sine in DEGREES using a 46-entry lookup table with interpolation.
routines.notes: About 0.25% accurate; basis for fCos/fTan. Bundled per page as fmath.bas.

routines.name: fSqrt
syntax: FUNCTION FASTCALL fSqrt(radicand as FLOAT) as FLOAT

parameters.name: radicand
parameters.notes: sign bit cleared, so negatives are treated as positive

routines.summary: Float square root by Newton-Raphson, same result as ROM SQR but about 6x faster.
routines.notes: Bundling status not stated on the page (listed as non-standard in library.md).

routines.name: fTan
routines.summary: Fast Fixed-point tangent in DEGREES: fSin(num) / fSin(90 - num).
routines.notes: Requires fSin.

routines.name: GetBank
routines.summary: Returns the RAM bank currently paged at $c000, read from system variable BANKM.
routines.notes: Danger: programs extending past $c000 may break.

routines.name: GetKey
routines.summary: Waits for a key press and returns its ASCII code.
routines.notes: Cannot detect multiple keys; more efficient than INKEY$ strings. Example calls it as GetKey without parentheses.

routines.name: GetKeyScanCode
routines.summary: Returns the scan code(s) of the currently pressed key(s) bitwise-ORed, or 0; does not wait.
routines.notes: Multiple keys only detectable within the same keyboard row half. Page title mistakenly says GetKey.

routines.name: HEX
routines.summary: 8-character hexadecimal string of a 32-bit unsigned value.
routines.notes: Not in Sinclair BASIC; avoid multiple inclusion.

routines.name: HEX16
routines.summary: 4-character hex string of a 16-bit unsigned value (calls HEX).

routines.name: HEX8
routines.summary: 2-character hex string of an 8-bit unsigned value (calls HEX).
routines.notes: Not listed in identifier.md's library-name list (only HEX/HEX16 are).

routines.name: hMirror
syntax: Function fastcall hMirror(number as uByte) as uByte
routines.summary: Reverses the bit order of a byte (bit 7 to bit 0), e.g. to mirror sprite graphics.
routines.notes: Two listings: the first (unrolled loop, 25 bytes/96 T) is described as basically deprecated; use the second (17 bytes/66 T). Not bundled.

routines.name: HRPrint
syntax: HRPrint(x as uByte, y as uByte, char as uInteger, attribute as uByte, overprint as uByte)

parameters.name: char
parameters.notes: address of 8 UDG-style bytes; values <256 are taken as ROM charset codes

parameters.name: attribute
parameters.notes: attribute byte; 0 = do not touch attributes

parameters.name: overprint
parameters.notes: doc says 0/1; code comments: 0 direct, 0xB6 OR, 0xAE XOR

routines.summary: Prints an 8x8 character at any pixel position, optionally setting attributes.
routines.notes: Attribute blocks cannot align with off-grid characters, so neighbouring cells change colour. Example includes it as #include "hrprint.bas". Not bundled.

routines.name: HRPrintFast
syntax: HRPrintFast(x AS UBYTE, y AS UBYTE, char AS UInteger, attribute AS UBYTE, overprint AS UBYTE)
routines.summary: Table-driven variant of HRPrint, ~20% faster per character but much larger.
routines.notes: Needs Screentables.asm and RotateTables.asm (download from forum; not on the wiki). The doc's usage line still says HRPrint(...).

routines.name: INPUT
routines.summary: Library function: shows a cursor, reads a line and returns it as a String when ENTER is pressed.
routines.notes: Not equivalent to Sinclair's INPUT statement: it is a function returning a string, and the cursor appears at the last print position (use PRINT AT to place it).

routines.name: INPUT42
routines.summary: Simple INPUT that echoes through the 42-column PRINT42 routine.
routines.notes: Always returns a string; cursor at last print position; avoid multiple inclusion; not like Sinclair INPUT.

routines.name: iSqrt
syntax: FUNCTION FASTCALL iSqrt(num as uLong) as uInteger
routines.summary: Integer square root (floor), 50-100x faster than ROM SQR.
routines.notes: 16-bit fast path for num < 65536 (~100x), 32-bit path otherwise (~50x). Same result as INT(SQR(x)). Not bundled.

routines.name: KEYS.BAS SCAN CODES
routines.summary: Global UInteger constants KEYA..KEYZ, KEY0..KEY9, KEYSPACE, KEYENTER, KEYSYMBOL, KEYCAPS encoding row-half and bit for each Spectrum key.
routines.notes: Values listed on page (e.g. KEYH = 0BF10h, KEYSPACE = 07F01h). Faster and smaller than INKEY$; no ROM needed.

routines.name: LEFT
routines.summary: First N characters of a string (whole string if shorter).
routines.notes: Equivalent to s$(TO N - 1) with 0-based strings. No padding.

routines.name: megaLZDepack
syntax: megaLZDepack(source as uInteger, dest as uInteger)
routines.summary: Decompresses a MegaLZ (v4) packed block from source to dest.
routines.notes: Depacker is 110 bytes, relocatable, interrupt-safe. Beware overlapping packed/unpacked areas (put packed block at highest addresses, leave a gap). Use asm incbin to embed data.

routines.name: MID
routines.summary: Up to N characters of a string starting at position start (0-based).
routines.notes: Equivalent to s$(start TO start + N - 1); truncated at end of string; empty if start is past the end.

routines.name: MultiKeys
routines.returns: 0 if none, else pressed keys' bits

parameters.name: keycodes
parameters.notes: scan codes ORed together, same row half

routines.summary: Tests whether any of the given keys is pressed; result can be decoded with bAND to see which.
routines.notes: Multiple keys only within the same row half (same row, same 5-key group).

routines.name: paint
syntax: paint(x as uByte, y as uByte, width as uByte, height as uByte, attribute as ubyte)
routines.summary: Fills a character rectangle of the attribute area with one attribute byte.
routines.notes: Also listed in docs/library/windowpaint.md. No bounds checking. Not bundled.

routines.name: paintData
syntax: paintData(x as uByte, y as uByte, width as uByte, height as uByte, address as uInteger)

parameters.name: address
parameters.notes: source attribute data, rows then columns

routines.summary: Copies a block of attribute bytes (row-major) to a character rectangle.
routines.notes: Data order is rows-then-columns, opposite to putChars' pixel data. No bounds checking.

routines.name: PixelScrollUp
routines.summary: Scrolls the whole pixel screen up by N pixel rows, blanking the rows uncovered; attributes untouched.
routines.notes: Requires the ScreenTables.bas file (Dropbox link on page) via #include once. Uses 32 unrolled LDIs (a smaller LDIR variant is commented).

routines.name: POINT
routines.summary: 1 if the pixel at (x, y) is set, else 0.
routines.notes: Extends Sinclair (rows 22/23 allowed). Included automatically with -Z/--sinclair.

routines.name: POS
routines.summary: Horizontal (column) position of the text cursor, 0 = leftmost.
routines.notes: Not in Sinclair BASIC. Page gives no explicit syntax line; name overlaps user identifiers (identifier.md).

routines.name: print42
routines.summary: Prints a string in 6-pixel-wide (42 column) characters at the print42 cursor using permanent colours.
routines.notes: Fixed-width, not proportional; attribute grid mismatch makes paper/bright/flash look imperfect.

routines.name: print64
routines.summary: Prints a string in 4-pixel-wide (64 column) characters at the print64 cursor.
routines.notes: Cursor independent of PRINT/print42. Doc's usage section mislabels the print call as printat64(STRING). Attributes written from system variable 23693.

routines.name: Print64x32
routines.summary: Prints a string on a 64x32 grid (4x6 pixel cells, 2048 positions).
routines.notes: Does not touch attributes. Needs ScreenTables.asm from the forum. Wraps to top when past row 31.

routines.name: Print64x32At
syntax: Print64x32At(y as uByte, x as uByte)
routines.summary: Sets the 64x32 print cursor (y 0-31, x 0-63).

routines.name: Print64x32StringAt
syntax: Print64x32StringAt(y as ubyte, x as ubyte, text$ as string)
routines.summary: Combines Print64x32At and Print64x32.

routines.name: printat42
routines.summary: Moves the print42 cursor to row y (0-23), column x (0-41).

routines.name: printat64
syntax: printat64(y as uByte, x as uByte)
routines.summary: Moves the print64 cursor to row y (0-23), column x (0-63).
routines.notes: Out-of-range values raise ROM error '5 Out of screen' (rst 8).

routines.name: propPrint
syntax: propPrint(x as ubyte, y as ubyte, spacesize as ubyte, xgap as ubyte, txt$ as string)

parameters.name: x
parameters.notes: pixel X (note x,y order, unlike PRINT)

routines.summary: Proportional-width text printing at any pixel position.
routines.notes: Not for tables (letter positions vary). Draws with XOR. By Odenthal/LCD. Not bundled.

routines.name: putChars
syntax: putChars(x as uByte, y as uByte, width as uByte, height as uByte, dataAddress as uInteger)

parameters.name: dataAddress
parameters.notes: 8 bytes per char, top-left to bottom-right, first column then next

routines.summary: Copies a block of 8-byte character bitmaps to the screen at character coordinates (column-major data).
routines.notes: WARNING: no screen-edge checking. Usable for character-based sprites. Not bundled.

routines.name: putTile
syntax: putTile(x as uByte, y as uByte, graphicsAddr as uInteger)

parameters.name: graphicsAddr
parameters.notes: 36 bytes: 16 rows x 2 bytes, then 2+2 attribute bytes

routines.summary: Copies a 16x16 pixel (2x2 char) tile plus its 4 attributes to character position (x, y) using PUSH/POP.
routines.notes: Uses all registers incl. alternates, IX/IY and SP; disables interrupts during copy and restores their state. Not bundled.

routines.name: randomBase
routines.summary: Patrik Rak's stream generator core: pseudo-random byte 0-255 (same generator ZX BASIC uses internally).
routines.notes: Other routines CALL the asm label 'random' inside it; keep that label. Not bundled.

routines.name: randomFixed
routines.summary: Random Fixed value between 0 and 1, faster than Float RND.

routines.name: randomLimit
syntax: FUNCTION fastcall randomLimit(limit as uByte) as uByte
routines.summary: Random integer from 0 to limit inclusive (e.g. randomLimit(5)+1 for a die).
routines.notes: Rejection sampling: ~1.5 draws on average, not constant time.

routines.name: RIGHT
routines.summary: Last N characters of a string (whole string if shorter).
routines.notes: Page gives equivalence s$(len(s$) - N - 1 TO), which looks off by one; second example wrongly uses left().

routines.name: scrAddress
syntax: scrAddress(x as uByte, y as uByte) as UInteger
routines.summary: Address of the top pixel line of character cell (x, y); following lines are +256 each.
routines.notes: Page also repeats attrAddress. Not bundled.

routines.name: SCREEN$
routines.summary: Returns the character displayed at (row, col) if it matches the current font.
routines.notes: Rows 22/23 allowed. Auto-available with -Z/--sinclair. identifier.md lists it as SCREEN.

routines.name: SetBank
routines.summary: Pages RAM bank 0-7 into $c000-$ffff and updates BANKM.
routines.notes: Danger if the program extends past $c000.

routines.name: SetCodeBank
routines.summary: Copies the given bank into the $8000 slot (memorybank.md), for the architecture in chapter 14 of the Boriel BASIC book.
routines.notes: Its own page's description repeats SetBank's text ('places the bank at $c000'), contradicting memorybank.md's 'copies to $8000'; example verifies via PEEK($8000). Bank 2 contents beyond $8000-$bfff are destroyed.

routines.name: time
routines.summary: Returns the ROM FRAMES counter (23672-23674) as a uLong.

routines.name: updateSeed
routines.summary: Re-seeds randomBase from the FRAMES counter.
routines.notes: Requires the time() function; call after some user interaction for better entropy.

routines.name: windowPaint
syntax: windowPaint(x as uByte, y as uByte, width as uByte, height as uByte, inkCol as ubyte, paperCol as uByte, isBright as uByte, isFlash as uByte)
routines.summary: Sets attributes for a character rectangle from separate ink/paper/bright/flash values (wraps paint).
routines.notes: WARNING: no edge checking. Bitmap untouched. Not bundled.
